text: Developing a successful mobile app is an exciting but complex process. One of the first big decisions you face is choosing between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built specifically for one system, like iOS or Android, using its unique language. This often results in better performance because the app can use the device’s full power. On the other hand, cross-platform tools let you write one code that works on both systems, which saves time and money. However, you might see a slight drop in speed or smoothness. Another crucial element is responsive design. Since users have different screen sizes, your layout must adapt seamlessly. Finally, before publishing, you must ensure your app meets the strict guidelines of app stores like the Apple App Store or Google Play, as this review process can take time.
